feeds.title: Daily News Egypt
feeds.description: Daily News Egypt is the only independent daily newspaper in English. Discuss the country's latest with the paper's reporters, editors, and other readers. Read the news on politics, business, opinion, lifestyle, and culture, featuring a close-up of life in Egypt.

feeds.title: Egyptian Streets
feeds.description: Egyptian Streets is an independent, young, and grassroots news media organization aimed at providing readers with an alternate depiction of events that occur on Egyptian and Middle Eastern streets and establishing an engaging social platform for readers to discover and discuss the various issues that impact the region.

feeds.title: Identity Magazine
feeds.description: Identity magazine is the ultimate lifestyle magazine in Egypt, helping its readers by featuring fashion, lifestyle, beauty, style & relationship advice. Identity is also a monthly fashion and lifestyle magazine bringing you the latest and hottest trends in Egypt and worldwide!

feeds.title: Egypt Oil & Gas News
feeds.description: Egypt Oil & Gas is the leading information provider for the Egyptian petroleum industry, offering a monthly publication, daily updates, concession maps, industry and analysis reports; in addition to major industry events.

feeds.title: Egyptian Chronicles | Egypt and Middle-East News Blog
feeds.description: Egyptian Chronicles is a news blog about Egypt, its news , its politics, its social affairs as well the Middle east issues and affairs.

feeds.title: Egypt at the Manchester Museum
feeds.description: Everything Egyptian at the Manchester Museum.The Manchester Museum houses over 18,000 objects from ancient Egypt and Sudan, making one of the largest collections in Britain and one with world-class holdings in a number of areas.

feeds.title: Hannah Pethen
feeds.description: Find articles on Archaeology and Egyptology in the 21st century. Current archaeological fieldwork, survey, technology and opinion, with a particular focus on Egypt. Freelance archaeologist and independent researcher, specialising in satellite remote sensing, GIS, archaeological survey and the archaeology of ancient Egypt.

feeds.title: The Guardian » Egypt
feeds.description: Latest news and features about Egypt from the guardian.com, the world's leading liberal voice

feeds.title: Discovering Ancient Egypt
feeds.description: News about ancient Egypt as well as temple reconstructions and other Egyptian artworks by Mark Millmore.Discovering Ancient Egypt pharaohs, pyramids, temples, mummification, Egyptian gods hieroglyphic write your name in hieroglyphs Hieroglyphic Typewriter.

feeds.title: The Arabist | Popular Arab Website
feeds.description: The Arabist was launched in Cairo in November 2003, by Issandr El Amrani, partly in response to the the lack of interest in the domestic politics of Arab countries in much Western media. It has long focused on Egypt but also follows broader issues in the Arab world, US policy in the Middle East, the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, and cultural developments throughout the region.

feeds.title: Nile Scribes
feeds.description: Your Portal to Ancient Egypt.Moderated by Toronto-based Taylor and Thomas, Nile Scribes is a new blog that posts weekly on the latest in Egyptology.

feeds.title: The Egyptiana Emporium
feeds.description: Egyptological news, museum pieces, research and more.

feeds.title: Amun-Ra Egyptology
feeds.description: This blog is all about Egyptology. Its aim: to bring Egyptology news and to discover the fascinating world of the Ancient Egyptians.

feeds.title: The Egyptian Kitchen Blog
feeds.description: I am Annie. I've always loved to cook and I've always loved learning about my Egyptian heritage. As the first generation born outside of Egypt, my connection to the country has been primarily through food, not language. I created this blog to introduce people to my favourite foods that are found in Egypt, and explain the historical or cultural background of each dish or ingredient.

feeds.title: Unearthing Egyptology
feeds.description: My name is Janet Diamond and I deliver presentations on Egyptology. With the talks I endeavour to put together various pieces of a jigsaw puzzle of what is the longest lasting Empire in history into a simple and enjoyable format 'Egyptology Made Easy' as it were… My fascination for Egyptology arose from living in the country.

feeds.title: Medicaregate
feeds.description: Read the blog to get more insights and information on health, diseases and more. MedicareGate is a free open-source of medical information that aims to clarify common misconceptions to the general public as well as providing high-quality medical content from a scientific perspective for the medical students.

feeds.title: Eleven Uniform Blog
feeds.description: Find the latest buzz surrounding the work and school uniform market in Egypt. Discover uniform options, tips, and recommendations. Eleven Uniform is a uniform manufacturing company in Cairo that provides all forms of uniforms with high-quality materials that compete with all materials in the Egyptian market.

feeds.title: DemonThings
feeds.description: This website serves as a portal for the subject of liminal entities in Ancient Egypt from its earliest times (Predynastic) to the Byzantine. The word 'demon' is used here to refer to any helpful or hostile being that does not belong to the Ancient Egyptian categories of major god, human, or animal.
